paper.title: Algorithm 462: Bivariate normal distribution (BIVNOR)
paper.venue: Communications of the ACM 16(10), 1973, p. 638; collected as TOMS Algorithm 462

claim.text: BIVNOR(h=0.8, k=-1.5, r=-0.9), the standard bivariate normal CDF, as the shipped reference output (archive file Fortran/Dp/Drivers/res) prints it in its first row: 0.147355, printed with g14.6 (six significant digits).

reference.archive: netlib.org/toms/462.gz sha256 547505dbaaa2b140deffa1ed3f90c133d637b70502e468b0dc8a26c09ad88aa0 (member Fortran/Dp/Drivers/res, extracted by the recipe; row 1 BIVNOR 0.147355)

attempt: The archive's Makefile as shipped does not build: it expects src.f and erf.f in the Drivers directory, but the shar puts them in Src/ (make: No rule to make target 'src.f'). Build-only workaround: a directory of symlinks to the unedited archive files (Makefile, driver.f, src.f, erf.f), then the Makefile's own target 'make F77=gfortran F77OPTS=-O2 -std=legacy Res'. No source byte is edited (manifests pre == mid == post for sources). Produced row 1: BIVNOR 0.147355, identical to the shipped res row 1.

original_attempt.reason: Makefile as shipped: 'make: *** No rule to make target src.f, needed by src.o. Stop.' driver.f compiled; src.f not found in Drivers/.

diagnostics.precision: The printed value has 6 significant digits; the comparison is at that printed precision, so the tolerance 5e-7 is the rounding half-unit of the printed value. The computed value is not compared to more digits here.

build_commands: cd /work/build && export PATH=/work/env16/bin:$PATH && timeout 600 make F77=gfortran "F77OPTS=-O2 -std=legacy" Res; echo "make exit=$?"

replayed.why: recipe printed no VALUE line for ['BIVNOR(0.8, -1.5, -0.9)']
